mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (post_id, user_id, parent_id, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.username, u.avatar_url FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.id = #{id}
SELECT c.*, u.username, u.avatar_url FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.is_best_answer DESC, c.create_time ASC
SELECT c.*, u.username, u.avatar_url FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY c.create_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE comment SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE comment SET is_best_answer = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE comment SET is_best_answer = 0 WHERE post_id = #{postId}
